trigger.description: Create a service to capture data changes from an Oracle database using CDC

metadata.label: Table
metadata.description: The fully-qualified table name to capture events from. Format: `<database>.<schema>.<table>`

section.label: Configure Oracle CDC Listener
section.description: Select an existing Oracle CDC listener or create a new one

createNew.label: Create new
createNew.description: Create a new Oracle CDC listener

useExisting.label: Use existing
useExisting.description: Select an existing Oracle CDC listener

existingListener.label: Listener(s)
existingListener.description: Select one or more existing listeners to attach to.

metadata.label: Listener Name
metadata.description: Provide a name for the listener being created

metadata.label: Host
metadata.description: The hostname of the Oracle server

metadata.label: Port
metadata.description: The port number of the Oracle listener

metadata.label: Database name
metadata.description: For multitenant Oracle, enter the CDB name. For legacy non-CDB Oracle, enter the database name.

metadata.label: Pluggable Database (PDB) Name
metadata.description: The PDB containing the schemas and tables to capture. Leave empty only for legacy non-CDB Oracle databases.

metadata.label: Username
metadata.description: The username for the Oracle database connection

metadata.label: Password
metadata.description: The password for the Oracle database connection

metadata.label: Schemas
metadata.description: A list of regular expressions that match names of schemas to capture changes from

metadata.label: Insert events
metadata.description: When enabled, the CDC listener will capture INSERT events

metadata.label: Update events
metadata.description: When enabled, the CDC listener will capture UPDATE events

metadata.label: Delete events
metadata.description: When enabled, the CDC listener will capture DELETE events

metadata.label: Advanced Configurations
metadata.description: Advanced driver, offset storage, and schema history settings.

metadata.label: Driver TLS
metadata.description: mTLS client authentication for Oracle: supply either a Java keystore/truststore, or an Oracle Wallet location string.

metadata.label: Options
metadata.description: Additional options for the CDC engine

metadata.label: Liveness Interval
metadata.description: Interval in seconds for the CDC engine liveness check

metadata.label: Internal Schema Storage
metadata.description: Storage configuration for the internal schema history

metadata.label: Offset Storage
metadata.description: Storage configuration for CDC offsets

metadata.label: CDC Service
metadata.description: Handles Oracle change-data-capture events (row reads, inserts, updates, deletes) delivered by the attached Oracle CDC listener.

service.description: A CDC service is a distinct service object that defines remote methods to handle database change events. Handler methods (onRead/onCreate/onUpdate/onDelete/onError) are recognised by convention, not declared on the type.
